history.summary: Freehold 1BR at $780k and $1,343 PSF, 330m from Aljunied MRT — a cheap, well-located city-fringe entry but on a thin 8-transaction series with mediocre 1.9%/yr growth. Boutique freehold shoebox: low entry, niche exit.
history.rating_rationale: Strong points: freehold, 330m to Aljunied (very walkable), low $780k absolute, PSF 1343 well below the 1582 median. Against it: only 8 URA txns so the 1.9%/yr rate is unreliable, it is a 1BR shoebox in a small boutique block (Metro Loft is tiny), and 1BR units have the narrowest resale demand. Good for a rental-yield play, not a conviction appreciation buy.
red_flags: 1BR shoebox in a small boutique development — niche, illiquid resale
catalysts: Freehold + 330m to Aljunied MRT supports steady rental demand
Paya Lebar Central / airbase relocation transformation in D14
Low absolute entry keeps it accessible to investors

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Best-in-class rental case for the batch's 1BRs — freehold, 330m to MRT, city-fringe — should achieve a solid gross yield on a $780k basis; tenant pool of singles/couples is steady near Aljunied.

history.summary: The cleanest of this batch: no red flags, a real same-size cohort (psf_cohort_txns=8), and a genuine, web-verified discount. Asking $1,342 psf sits ~16% below the project's real recent-12mo $1,604 psf average. Value is the strongest forward signal in v3.4 and here it is credible rather than artifactual - tempered by Geylang stigma and thin building liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Listing $780,000 / 581 sqft = $1,342 psf. Web confirms Metro Loft (FH, 2016, 31 units, Lorong 27 Geylang) recent-12mo transactions of $1,593-$1,615 psf (avg ~$1,604), with current listings $1,655-$1,769 psf and ~4.7% yield. So $1,342 psf is a real ~16% discount to actual transacted PSF - not a data quirk: psf_cohort_txns=8 and age_adj_premium_pct -28.6% both rest on genuine comparables, and there are zero red flags. The sqft (581) and PSF are internally consistent and match a real 1BR. The offset: D14 Geylang FH structurally lags (avg ~$1,516 psf vs East ~$1,706, islandwide ~$1,953) with stigma-driven slow growth, and a 31-unit project transacts thinly, so exit valuation leans on few comps.
red_flags: Geylang stigma caps appreciation: D14 FH ~$1,516 psf lags East ~$1,706 / islandwide ~$1,953 with slow growth
Thin liquidity: 31-unit project, few annual transactions - valuation/exit depends on sparse comps
Small 1BR (581 sqft) appeals mainly to tenants/singles, narrower resale buyer pool
catalysts: Verified ~16% PSF discount to real recent transactions - genuine entry value
Aljunied (EW9) and Dakota (CC8) MRT within reach; strong F&B/rental catchment
Healthy rental yield (~4.7% project-level) supports holding income over a 5-7yr hold
Freehold + small absolute quantum ($780k) widens the buyer pool on exit
